schema: Table with observations derived from the media files. Associated with deployments (`deploymentID`). Observations can mark non-animal events (camera setup, human, blank) or one or more animal observations (`observationType` = `animal`) of a certain taxon, count, life stage, sex, behavior and/or individual. Observations can be made at different levels (`observationLevel`).
